items.review_rationale: Read finite ordered M-regular sequences through injectivity on successive quotient modules and separately the nonzero final quotient; did not confuse with a regular local ring.

references.context: Module obtained by modding out by the submodule generated by the previous sequence elements acting on M.
Multiplication-by-f_i endomorphism has zero kernel on the preceding quotient module.
The quotient M/(f_1,…,f_r)M must not be the zero R-module.

references.disposition: Order is part of the successive test; no condition on being a regular local ring is implied.
